# Functions

```{r}
doDAA <- function(a, group){
  dds <- calcNormFactors(DGEList(a, group=group))
  mm <- model.matrix(~group)
  dds <- estimateDisp(dds, mm)
  fit <- glmQLFit(dds, mm)
  d <- as.data.frame(topTags(glmQLFTest(fit), n=Inf, sort.by="none"))
  d$dispersion <- dds$tagwise.dispersion
  d
}
counts <- function(se) assay(se, "counts")

# assigns spiked logFCs to rows so that the signal is clustered in the bias space
spikeClustered <- function(se, lfc, signs=c("separate","mixed"), centre=NULL){
  signs <- match.arg(signs)
  bg   <- getBackgroundBins(se, verbose=FALSE)
  bin  <- bg@peak2bin - 1L
  dims <- bg@dims
  # bin = idx1 + (idx2-1)*bs1 [+ (idx3-1)*bs1*bs2] :
  stride <- cumprod(c(1, dims))[seq_along(dims)]
  xy <- sapply(seq_along(dims), function(d) (bin %/% stride[d]) %% dims[d])
  if(is.null(centre)) centre <- sample(nrow(se), 1)
  d <- sqrt(rowSums(sweep(xy, 2, xy[centre,])^2))
  sel <- order(d + runif(length(d), 0, 1e-6))[seq_along(lfc)]
  lfc <- if(signs=="mixed") sample(lfc) else sort(lfc, decreasing=TRUE)
  setNames(lfc, row.names(se)[sel])
}


# one simulation (sampling of the samples per group & spiking-in)
doIter <- function(i, balanced=TRUE, lfc.scale=0.1, n=20000, clustered=FALSE){
  lfcs <- rgamma(n, shape=10, scale = lfc.scale)*sign(rnorm(n))
  if(isTRUE(clustered)){
    lfcs <- spikeClustered(se, lfcs)
  }else if(isFALSE(clustered)){
    names(lfcs) <- sample(grep("^chr[1-9]", row.names(se), value=TRUE), n)
  }else{
    stopifnot(clustered >0 & clustered <1)
    lfcs <- spikeClustered(se, lfcs)
    i <- sample.int(length(lfcs), round(length(lfcs)*(1-clustered)))
    names(lfcs)[i] <- sample(grep("^chr[1-9]",
                                  setdiff(row.names(se), names(lfcs)[-i]),
                                  value=TRUE), n)
  }
  if(!isFALSE(balanced)){
    if(isTRUE(balanced)) balanced <- 3
    se2 <- se[,sample.int(ncol(se), balanced*2)]
    se2$group <- rep(LETTERS[1:2], each=balanced)
  }else{
    se2 <- se
    se2$group <- "A"
    while(length(unique(se2$group))<2 || min(table(se2$group))<3){
      se2$group <- sample(LETTERS[1:2], ncol(se), replace=TRUE)
    }    
  }
  assay(se2)[names(lfcs),se2$group=="B"] <- round(as.matrix(assay(se2))[names(lfcs),se2$group=="B"] * 2^lfcs)
  res1 <- doDAA(assay(se2), se2$group)
  se2 <- CVnorm(se2)
  res2 <- doDAA(assay(se2, "corrected"), se2$group)
  se2 <- CVnorm(se2, grouping = se2$group)
  res3 <- doDAA(assay(se2, "corrected"), se2$group)
  assay(se2, "GCQN") <- GCQuantileNorm(se2)
  res4 <- doDAA(assay(se2, "GCQN"), se2$group)
  assay(se2, "GCsmQN") <- GCSmoothQuantile(se2, bio="group")
  res5 <- doDAA(assay(se2, "GCsmQN"), se2$group)
  l <- lapply(list(raw=res1, CVnorm=res2, smCVnorm=res3, GCQN=res4, GCsmQN=res5), \(d){
    d$truth <- row.names(d) %in% names(lfcs)
    d$true.lfc <- lfcs[row.names(d)]
    d$true.lfc[is.na(d$true.lfc)] <- 0
    d
  })
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(l, \(d){
    d <- data.frame(TP=sum(d$FDR<0.05 & d$truth),
                    FP=sum(d$FDR<0.05 & !d$truth),
                    lfc.cor=cor(d$logFC, d$true.lfc),
                    p.TP=sum(d$PValue<0.05 & d$truth),
                    p.FP=sum(d$PValue<0.05 & !d$truth),
                    mean.disp=mean(d$dispersion),
                    median.disp=median(d$dispersion)
      )
    d$FDR <- d$FP/(d$TP+d$FP)
    d$sensitivity <- d$TP/n
    d
  }), .id="method")
}
```


# Bysani dataset

```{r}
set.seed(123)
se <- readRDS("Bysani2019ctrl.SE.rds")
se <- se[!grepl("chrM", seqnames(se)),]

res1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), balanced=TRUE, lfc.scale=0.09, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res1$setting <- "balanced (mild)"
res2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), balanced=TRUE, lfc.scale=0.12, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res2$setting <- "balanced (strong)"
res3 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), clustered=0.6, lfc.scale=0.15, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res3$setting <- "clustered (strong)"

res <- rbind(res1, res2, res3)
saveRDS(res, file="Bysani_spikingRes.rds")
```




# Waag et al. data

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
set.seed(123)
se <- readRDS("../Waag_et_al_data/bulkATAC.SE.rds")
mm <- model.matrix(~Sex+Group, data=as.data.frame(colData(se)))
se <- se[filterByExpr(assay(se),mm),]
se <- se[,which(se$Group=="Control")]
se <- se[rowSums(assay(se)>=10)>1,]
row.names(se) <- paste0("chr",row.names(se))

res1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), n=12000, balanced=4, lfc.scale=0.05, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res1$setting <- "4vs4\n(mild)"
res2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), n=12000, balanced=4, lfc.scale=0.1, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res2$setting <- "4vs4\n(strong)"
res3 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), n=12000, clustered=0.6, lfc.scale=0.12, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res3$setting <- "4vs4 clustered\n(strong)"

res4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), n=12000, balanced=6, lfc.scale=0.05, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res4$setting <- "6vs6\n(mild)"

res5 <- dplyr::bind_rows(bplapply(1:10, BPPARAM=MulticoreParam(10, RNGseed=123), n=12000, balanced=6, lfc.scale=0.1, doIter),
                         .id="iteration")
res5$setting <- "6vs6\n(strong)"


res <- rbind(res1, res2, res4, res5, res3)
saveRDS(res, file="Waag_spikingRes.rds")
```
